data.standardized_narrative: Insufficiently clear information in the scanned report images to determine a gross prior-year movement. The balance sheet shows a gross claims outstanding prior year comparative figure of approximately 105.6 (2014) million GBP. No unambiguous gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure could be extracted from the available pages.
data.data_quality_notes: Source documents provided as low-resolution scanned images. I located a 'Claims outstanding' row on the liabilities/technical provisions page and read the prior-year comparative (2014) gross claims outstanding as ~105.6m GBP (opening_reserves_gbp_m). However the detailed Technical Provisions movement note that should state the gross prior-year development could not be reliably read/extracted from the scans. No clear verbatim sentence describing the gross prior-year reserve movement was found. Many tables and numeric cells are partially illegible; therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is set to null. If a higher-quality scan or original PDF is provided I can extract exact gross movement, triangle and segmental premium lines precisely.
